footnotes:
Seals, O-rings, back-up rings and packings are serviced only in the Seal Repair Kit (C42740), which includes all packings, wear rings, O-rings, back-up rings and wipers for one cylinder.
IMPORTANT: Replace the cylinder nut any time it must be removed. Torque the nut to 140 lb.-ft.
Also listed, not shown on diagram:
- C42634 Complete Cylinder - Stabilizer
- C42740 Seal Repair Kit (includes all Packings, Wear Rings, O-Rings, Back-Up Rings, and Wipers for one cylinder)
